name: East Communities YMCA
known_for: The outdoor pool is the draw, and free childcare while you train seals it for parents.

plans.name: Adult
plans.note: Standard adult rate across the 8 community fitness centers. Rate published association-wide by the YMCA of Greater Austin, not per branch — membership admits you to every branch. Read from austinymca.org/join; no branch-specific variation is published, and none is assumed.

promo.note: $0 join fee — a $49 saving. Limited-time offer, no code needed.
